title: Offline export / import bundle manifest
description: Offline export and import (spec 10865). A bundle is a self-contained, signed slice of a registry: the selected index entries, their manifests, their payload files, the revocation list and the advisory list AT EXPORT TIME. Carrying the revocation and advisory lists is the whole point -- an air-gapped import that ships packages WITHOUT them would import exactly the revoked versions the online path refuses, which is the same failure mode as a revocation that does not block.

includes.description: Declared so an import can REFUSE a bundle that omits a list the consumer's trust policy requires, instead of importing it and silently having nothing to check against.
